requirement: The host shall bind and exclusively lease each target by durable identity rather than COM number.
acceptance: Swap USB enumeration and start a second manager; identity stays correct and concurrent ownership is rejected.

requirement: The host shall freeze board firmware checker configuration and schema identities before START.
acceptance: Wrong image or feature profile rejects START; requested and effective configurations and hashes remain in evidence.

requirement: The host shall supervise each board through an independent bounded asynchronous session.
acceptance: Hang one device and corrupt another while healthy devices complete without lost supervision.

requirement: The host shall bound receive queues fragments process deadlines and evidence storage.
acceptance: Flood malformed input and exhaust configured log space; no unbounded growth occurs and incomplete evidence cannot pass.

requirement: The host shall distinguish target-time and operation goals from its wall-clock cutoff.
acceptance: An early host cutoff remains incomplete even when all received heartbeats were healthy.

requirement: The host shall validate board-specific limits required capabilities and expected fault outcomes before arming.
acceptance: Missing timing limits or unsupported required features reject the plan; optional omissions are explicit skips.

requirement: The host shall archive raw frames decoded records command chronology initial fault and completeness metadata.
acceptance: Replay the bundle offline and reproduce decoding and verdict without a connected target.

requirement: The host shall issue PASS only when all required target and equipment assertions and run goals pass.
acceptance: Matching CRC with missing records or a missing checker result is failed or incomplete rather than PASS.

requirement: The host shall re-identify boot and session state after reset or reconnect without silently resuming a run.
acceptance: Replay old ACK and RESULT frames after reset; they cannot complete the new run.

requirement: The host shall provide a C# CLI for plan enumeration seeded campaigns status retrieval and result export.
acceptance: The same manifest reproduces test inputs and configuration while recording physical schedule variability.

requirement: The host shall perform reset recovery only under a declared per-run reset policy after preserving available evidence.
acceptance: A stuck board is classified before an allowed reset; healthy boards are not reset.

requirement: The host shall retain per-device verdicts and expose failures and infrastructure errors in aggregate CLI results.
acceptance: A mixed passed failed and disconnected campaign cannot return an all-passed result.

requirement: The monitor shall use permanent boot-registered workers and queues with static storage.
acceptance: Repeated runs change job generations without runtime thread creation deletion or new stack allocation.

requirement: The monitor shall enforce the declared run state machine and return effective configuration with command acknowledgements.
acceptance: START before configuration and REARM during active ownership fail without changing run state.

requirement: The monitor shall activate workloads only by allowlisted test worker and object identifiers.
acceptance: Unknown IDs and requests for arbitrary addresses or kernel-field writes are rejected before side effects.

requirement: The monitor shall distinguish accepted START from completion of the worker start barrier.
acceptance: START ACK is followed by started status only when every selected worker reaches the barrier within its configured deadline.

requirement: The monitor shall stop cooperatively by ending admission settling jobs releasing workload locks and proving test-device quiescence.
acceptance: Stop during computation sleep queue wait mutex ownership and DMA activity; successful stop has no unaccounted work or live test ownership while idle control waiters remain valid.

requirement: The monitor shall report STOP_TIMEOUT when its declared quiescence deadline is exceeded.
acceptance: A noncooperating worker remains occupied and evidence is preserved; it is not forcibly killed or reported stopped.

requirement: The monitor shall forbid queue reset deletion or reconstruction while callers or waiters can reference the object.
acceptance: A drain request during active producers is rejected; a quiescent drain uses ordinary receives and accounts discarded messages.

requirement: The monitor shall tag jobs and handles with run generations and reject stale or exhausted identities.
acceptance: Replay prior-run messages and exhaust a finite generation fixture; neither aliases a current job or silently wraps.

requirement: The monitor shall use an owned static frame pool and queue only bounded descriptors or commands.
acceptance: No 512-byte packet copy occurs through Queue<T>; pool exhaustion preserves transport ownership and reports backpressure.

requirement: The monitor shall bound parsing snapshot collection and transport service work and serialize reports outside interrupt masks.
acceptance: A command flood or stalled host does not exceed declared service and interrupt-residency budgets; source snapshot cost is measured.

requirement: The monitor shall feed the watchdog only through a supervisor checking expected worker progress.
acceptance: USB traffic continues while a required worker stalls; the supervisor withholds feeding and equipment observes the configured failure or reset.

requirement: The monitor shall retain fault and result separately and return to IDLE only after terminal acknowledgement safe test-resource quiescence and prior-run handle invalidation.
acceptance: Status saturation cannot overwrite the first fault; unresolved test DMA quarantine or workload waiters prevent REARM while permanent idle control waiters remain valid.

requirement: Equipment shall identify its hardware bitstream configuration and pairing with each target.
acceptance: A checker connected to the wrong target or with mismatched configuration cannot qualify the run.

requirement: Equipment shall timestamp stimuli and witnesses against an independent characterized clock.
acceptance: Archive frequency resolution drift and capture uncertainty with each timing result.

requirement: Equipment shall distinguish stimulus-to-handler and handler-to-worker latency using declared GPIO witnesses.
acceptance: Known edge intervals verify measurement paths; USB arrival times are never used as interrupt-latency measurements.

requirement: The UART checker shall observe the physical TX pin and validate UART framing at declared baud and clock tolerance.
acceptance: An AXI write with a corrupted pin transmission fails the pin-level checker.

requirement: The UART checker shall independently verify per-worker payload sequence counts and completion marker.
acceptance: Wrong data with a freshly valid CRC and an empty or truncated stream both produce a non-pass verdict.

requirement: Equipment shall arm freeze snapshot and clear captures through acknowledged session-bound operations.
acceptance: Read multiword counters during updates without torn values; retain first mismatch until archived.

requirement: Equipment shall expose overflow unarmed and incomplete capture as explicit invalid evidence.
acceptance: Force observer overflow and omit the terminal marker; neither capture passes.

requirement: Each checker fault detector shall pass documented positive and negative sensitivity controls before qualification use.
acceptance: Inject payload framing missing-byte duplicate-record stuck-line and reset faults; verify the specified failure identity and location.

requirement: Equipment shall observe and control reset under a documented electrical contract.
acceptance: Measure reset pulse width and boot identity transition without resetting unrelated targets.

requirement: Each fixture shall declare voltage levels pin directions reset polarity and safe disconnected states.
acceptance: Review the board wiring manifest and verify no driven-line contention before enabling stimuli.

requirement: The bench shall retain telemetry-disabled and telemetry-enabled measurements under the same declared load.
acceptance: Report throughput interrupt residency and latency differences against predeclared interference limits.

requirement: RISCue-specific ECC TMR and RTL tests shall execute the identified RISCue implementation on FPGA.
acceptance: Commercial-core results are not substituted for RISCue fault-injection evidence.

requirement: Context tests shall check applicable integer registers stack pointer return PC and interrupt state across preemption and blocking.
acceptance: Meet the configured switch count with zero canary mismatches and preserve the first expected and observed register values.

requirement: Scheduler tests shall witness strict effective priority and configured equal-priority rotation at controlled boundaries.
acceptance: No unexpected lower-priority dispatch occurs while a higher-priority worker is ready; intentional starvation is declared by the profile.

requirement: Sleep and wait tests shall separate logical ready deadlines from later scheduling of the resumed worker.
acceptance: No early ready transition and exactly one wait resolution occur at timeout and completion races.

requirement: Timer tests shall cover delayed service multiple missed periods and tick wrap using identified fixtures.
acceptance: Logical tick advancement and wake decisions match an independent model without hidden production-clock mutation.

requirement: Queue tests shall conserve uniquely identified accepted messages through full empty wrap direct-handoff and timeout cases.
acceptance: Each accepted message is received once or explicitly remains in accounted backlog; zero unexplained losses or duplicates occur.

requirement: Mutex tests shall cover inversion chained donation restoration foreign unlock deadlock and held-lock budgets.
acceptance: Controlled low-owner medium-competitor high-waiter scenarios match declared inheritance and ownership rules.

requirement: Owner-death tests shall use designated sacrificial workers and require reset before their reuse.
acceptance: Waiters receive owner_dead without a silent grant; recovery requires resource quiescence and the finished worker is not restarted.

requirement: Event and semaphore tests shall enforce token conservation consumption broadcast and exactly-once boundary resolution.
acceptance: Overflow loses no token and invalid or failed operations preserve declared outputs and state.

requirement: Memory tests shall enforce static allocation and guard invariants and report bounded watermark scan completeness.
acceptance: No allocator or dynamic-initializer symbols occur and zero unexpected guard failures occur; paint observations are not treated as proven stack bounds.

requirement: Timing tests shall apply per-board limits selected before the run under declared interrupt and workload stress.
acceptance: External measurements include uncertainty and remain within the selected limits; observed maxima are not represented as WCET proof.

requirement: DMA tests shall use the actual supported peripheral and verify payload ownership cache operations cancellation and quarantine.
acceptance: Failed abort never permits staging reuse; unsupported physical DMA is explicitly skipped.

requirement: Release resource stress shall execute at least one million operations per enabled reusable class and reconcile inventories.
acceptance: Free plus active plus quarantined remains conserved and quiescent reusable resources return to baseline with every quarantine explained.

requirement: Concurrent UART tests shall emit whole seeded records from multiple workers and qualify them independently on the pin.
acceptance: Exact expected per-worker counts payloads and terminal marker pass with zero framing duplication loss or interleaving errors.

requirement: Protection tests shall exercise supported PMP privilege and atomic profiles with explicit expected fault policies.
acceptance: Denied accesses leave protected memory unchanged and optional unsupported features cannot be counted as passing coverage.

requirement: Watchdog and reset tests shall distinguish worker liveness from monitor responsiveness and transport health.
acceptance: Stall a required worker and observe the declared response while serial traffic remains active; preserve the first failure classification.

requirement: The campaign shall validate fault-detection mechanisms using predeclared injected failures in isolated profiles.
acceptance: Every required detector detects its injected condition and normal controls remain passing; destructive scenarios do not contaminate later runs.

requirement: Every version-1 logical packet shall contain exactly 512 decoded bytes with a 40-byte header and CRC over the first 508 bytes.
acceptance: Shared C++ C# and FPGA vectors agree on little-endian fields zero padding and CRC-32C.

requirement: COBS framing shall support up to 516 encoded bytes including delimiter with bounded resynchronization.
acceptance: Fragment concatenate corrupt oversize and truncate frames; reject bad input without state changes and recover at a later valid delimiter.

requirement: Mutating commands shall validate session and boot identity; CONFIG establishes a fresh run from IDLE and later commands validate current run and object generation.
acceptance: Old commands after reset reconnect or rearm never mutate the current run.

requirement: Command retries shall return cached outcomes without repeating START STOP or resource side effects.
acceptance: Exact duplicate executes once; changed payload with reused ID and older uncached IDs are rejected.

requirement: Retained faults and results shall use stable logical report IDs separate from transmission sequence numbers.
acceptance: A delayed ACK cannot release another report and repeated transmissions archive as one logical result.

requirement: Fragmented evidence shall carry a bounded total length record identity offset and integrity check.
acceptance: Missing overlapping conflicting or out-of-range fragments cannot establish complete evidence.

requirement: Snapshots shall declare field validity sample epochs and paging for thread counts beyond the fixed report slots.
acceptance: Unsupported measurements are distinguishable from zero and multi-page data from different epochs is not presented as one atomic snapshot.

requirement: Protocol payloads shall use explicit schemas and separate framed control from UART test data.
acceptance: Unknown mandatory types bad lengths nonzero padding and unframed text cannot cause command execution or a passing UART test.
